Subject: Executive QBR deck — draft review & OKR highlights

Team — attaching a working draft of the Q3 board/investor deck and the current OKR scorecard. Aim: finalize by EOD Monday so we have time for legal and slide polish before Wednesday's board packet distribution.

Quick asks:
- Please review the deck (attached: 2026-Q3-Deck-v0.3.pptx) and the OKR scorecard (OKR-scorecard.xlsx).
- Priority comments: product roadmap bullets, top-line growth slide, and the risk/backstop slide.
- If you have redlines, attach a marked-up deck or add comments directly in the Drive doc here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/QBR-2026-Q3

Timeline:
- Fri 7/10: exec comments due (especially GTM and finance)
- Mon 7/13 by 5pm PT: consolidated revisions due to me
- Wed 7/15: Board packet sent to board + investors

What I'm planning to emphasize: OKR progress (wins and gaps), predictable latency/cost improvements from the runtime work, Dedicated customer pipeline, and the Private deployment roadmap for compliance customers.

Attachments: 2026-Q3-Deck-v0.3.pptx (draft), OKR-scorecard.xlsx

Thanks — Evelyn

Evelyn — quick pass from finance run: looks good overall. Two notes:
1) Slide 4 (growth slide) should show ARR run-rate + quarter-over-quarter ARR change rather than MRR; investors will want ARR.
2) Please move the cost per token improvements into a single slide with a clear before/after table — CFO wants the unit economics called out up front.

I've attached a deck with my inline comments: 2026-Q3-Deck-v0.3-markus-comments.pptx. Small ask: include a succinct runway slide (3 bullets) so we don't get follow-ups on cash runway in the meeting.

-Markus
